baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَحَاطَ ... الرُّءْيَا ... فِتْنَةً ... نُخَوِّفُهُمْ ... يَزِيدُهُمْ ... طُغْيَانًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord's complete enclosure contains a staged exposure: showing supplies the specimen, fitna assays it, warning applies pressure, and the audience response both reveals and enlarges boundary-crossing overflow.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure in knowledge and possession supplies the controlled scope of the assay.
Showing and making visible supplies the exposed specimen within that scope.
Testing metal or a person turns the displayed material into a diagnostic assay.
Putting fear into another supplies the applied pressure intended to induce caution.
Increase and growth marks the counter-effect produced in the recipients.
Water rising into a sweeping force materializes transgression as an amplifying overflow.

changed_reading.before: The ayah juxtaposes divine enclosure, two troubling signs, warning, and greater disobedience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a contained diagnostic feedback loop in which signs and warning expose the recipients' disposition by eliciting an enlarging overflow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْنَا لَكَ ... الرُّءْيَا الَّتِي أَرَيْنَاكَ ... لِلنَّاسِ ... فِي الْقُرْآنِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Utterance, making, vision, showing, and gathered recitation form a transmission chain. A display given to one addressee becomes a public test through two media, the vision and the tree as recited sign, while the repeated people marks its social reception field.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance initiates the transmission chain addressed to the messenger.
Making something assume a state frames the vision as assigned test material rather than an accidental image.
Dream vision supplies one medium while the paired causative showing makes its transmission explicit.
Gathering and joining makes the Qur'anic tree part of a collected communicative medium.
Human society, repeated on both sides of the sign clause, supplies the public reception field.
The stemmed tree supplies the second concrete sign carried in recitation.
Expulsion under displeasure gives that second sign its warning charge.

changed_reading.before: A private vision and a cursed tree are two unrelated objects that happen to test people.
changed_reading.after: The ayah coordinates visual showing and recited object as two stages of one public sign-transmission problem.

baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant growth branch under the split mapping of rabb resonates with tree, increase, and flood-like transgression. The focus can therefore carry two opposed growths: encompassing nurture and an audience response that swells beyond its boundary.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growth, from the packet's split mapped root, supplies the constructive growth pole.
The stemmed tree gives the opposed growths an ecological body.
Increase and growth transfers the growth image to the recipients' reaction.
Water exceeding its measure turns the reaction's growth into material overflow.
Magnitude marks the countergrowth as no longer contained within a small deviation.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause reports an abstract increase in rebellion.
changed_reading.after: The closing clause can be pictured as countergrowth: warning meets a cultivated human field but the resistant growth swells into a flood.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 17:41 is a compact rehearsal of the focus: Qur'anic material is varied for recollection, yet it only increases aversion. The focus replaces varied reminder with vision, tree, and warning, and replaces aversion with great overflow, making the paradox a repeated reception pattern rather than an isolated failure.

activation_trace.role: Turning something through different states supplies repeated communicative variation.
Reading and recitation locates that variation in the same medium named in the focus.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the intended reception effect.
Increase and growth supplies the exact counter-effect operator repeated in the focus.
Drawing away from a thing names the earlier resistant output of that operator.
Crossing the limit intensifies the earlier aversion into active boundary violation.

structural_cues: Both 17:41 and 17:60 use ما ... إلا around يزيدهم ... إلا, with Qur'anic communication before the increase and a resistant state after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched grammar, medium, and counter-effect; I infer a recurrent receiver-side transformation law, while the live alternative is two independent descriptions that merely share diction.

changed_reading.before: The warning in 17:60 unexpectedly causes a one-time worsening.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the sharper recurrence of an established pattern in which communicative variation is converted by resistant reception into withdrawal and then overflowing transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claimed rival gods would seek a route toward the possessor of the elevated throne, while God is exalted with great elevation above what people say. The focus's great transgression then reads spatially as a counterfeit rise that crosses its proper limit.

activation_trace.role: Seeking a thing supplies directed movement toward a superior center.
The elevated royal throne supplies the vertical center toward which the hypothetical rivals move.
An extended traversable path turns hierarchy into a spatial route.
Height expressed as greatness and domination marks the vertical quality denied to human claims.
Magnitude forms the exact adjectival echo later attached to transgression.
Crossing the limit turns the recipients' rise into illegitimate vertical excess.
Greatness and self-exaltation qualifies that excess as counterfeit grandeur.

structural_cues: Verse 17:43 closes with عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا and the focus closes with طُغْيَانًا كَبِيرًا after the same human speech controversy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared adjective and a vertical throne-path sequence; I infer that the echo spatializes transgression as counterfeit elevation, while the live alternative is that كبيرًا only intensifies two unrelated nouns.

changed_reading.before: Great transgression means severe disobedience without a spatial mechanism.
changed_reading.after: Great transgression becomes an attempted upward overreach inside the very enclosure that makes rival height impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation is followed by an unseen covered barrier, protected coverings over hearts, weight in ears, and turning backs in aversion. The focus's shown vision is therefore not simply evidence made available; visual and recited disclosure pass through an occluding reception interface, and fitna discriminates orientations at that interface.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supplies the communicative event at which the barrier appears.
A covering barrier supplies blocked access despite an audible recitation.
Covering makes the barrier itself unavailable to ordinary inspection.
Protective concealment locates the occlusion at the heart's reception surface.
Weight in the ear adds an auditory obstruction to the hidden barrier.
Turning away converts internal occlusion into outward refusal.
Aversion as drawing away supplies the observable reception result.
Showing anchors the revised model in the focus's visual disclosure.
Assay makes the disclosure diagnostic of the occluded receiver rather than merely informative.

structural_cues: The sequence runs recitation to hidden barrier in 17:45, then covered hearts and weighted ears to turned backs in 17:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a multi-layer reception barrier around Qur'anic recitation; I infer that the same interface governs the focus's vision and tree, while the live alternative is that the barrier describes only the earlier recitation scene.

changed_reading.before: The signs are clear inputs that people consciously reject.
changed_reading.after: The signs test a layered reception apparatus in which disclosure and concealment coexist, so increased transgression is the output of an occluded interface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience listens, converts hearing into secret counsel, labels the messenger bewitched, and strikes its own similitudes. The focus's shown vision and tree-image are thus met by an active counter-image factory: recipients do not merely fail to see but substitute frames that redirect the sign.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception establishes that material reaches the recipients before being reframed.
Secret counsel supplies the social chamber in which an alternative frame is produced.
Diversion and deception supplies the audience's counter-description of the messenger.
Directed sight or insight makes the competing representations an explicit object of inspection.
Forming and displaying a similitude supplies the production act of the counter-image.
A pictured likeness supplies the representational product imposed on the messenger.
Departure from the intended way supplies the directional effect of that substitution.
Showing anchors the competition in the focus's presented visual material.
Representation in tree form lets the recited tree function as a shaped image within the competition.

structural_cues: Verse 17:47 moves from listening to private counsel and a label; 17:48 immediately identifies their act as striking similitudes and losing the way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reception followed by hostile representation; I infer that the focus's images activate counter-images, while the live alternative is that the labels answer the messenger generally rather than the vision or tree.

changed_reading.before: People remain unmoved by the vision and tree.
changed_reading.after: People actively metabolize the presented signs into rival representations, and that reframing is one mechanism by which warning becomes greater transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding challenge moves from pulverized remains to resurrection, stone, iron, and whatever seems greatest in the chest, before an originating fissure and an unavoidable call-response. Against that sequence, fitna as a metal assay answers an imagined hardened identity: the focus signs test what presents itself as unyielding material.

activation_trace.role: Pulverization and debris supplies the audience's material objection at its most disintegrated pole.
Rousing what is still supplies the opposed reactivation claimed to be impossible.
Hard stone supplies one imagined form of maximal resistance.
Iron and resistant hardness supplies the material specifically suited to an assay image.
The chest as the source of action locates imagined magnitude inside the resistant subject.
Opening and splitting supplies the creator's capacity to breach the hardened conception.
A verbal call supplies the eventual activation signal.
Answering speech supplies the response that penetrates the claimed resistance.
Testing metal transfers the preceding iron image into the focus's diagnostic mechanism.

structural_cues: Verses 17:49-52 progress from dust to stone and iron, to what is greater in the chest, to originating and answering a call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material-hardness sequence immediately before fitna's assay branch; I infer that the signs assay a self-hardened reception posture, while the live alternative is that the material list serves only the resurrection argument.

changed_reading.before: Fitna is a generic trial imposed on an abstract audience.
changed_reading.after: Fitna becomes a material assay of recipients who imagine resistance as dust, stone, iron, or something still greater within themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to use better speech is motivated by an adversarial incitement that works between humans. This activates the focus tree's interlaced speech-conflict branch: a warning entering social exchange can ramify through hostile prompting until the cursed branching pattern and increasing transgression mirror one another.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech supplies the medium in which the social mechanism operates.
Goodness opposed to ugliness marks the instructed alternative to conflict-producing speech.
Distance and severance supplies the adversarial tendency that breaks human relation.
Corrupting relations through incitement supplies the causal agitation between speakers.
The interval between parties supplies the relational space in which incitement branches.
The human collective supplies the same social field twice named in the focus.
Active enmity gives the branching speech network its hostile orientation.
Interlaced dispute and speech turns the focus tree into a model of ramifying social conflict.
Expulsion under displeasure marks that branching network as severed from good relation.
Growth supplies the propagation of conflict after warning enters the network.

structural_cues: Verse 17:53 repeats saying, locates incitement between humans, and immediately precedes the focus's repeated people, tree, warning, and increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, interhuman incitement, and the tree branch of interlaced dispute; I infer propagation from warning through a hostile social network, while the live alternative keeps the tree wholly botanical and the speech warning merely adjacent.

changed_reading.before: The cursed tree is an isolated object shown to individuals.
changed_reading.after: The tree can also model a socially branching conflict structure through which warning is reprocessed and multiplied among people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two statements of the Lord's knowledge surround the denial that the messenger was sent as custodian, followed by differentiated prophets and a written revelation. The focus's enclosure belongs to divine knowledge and governance; showing and warning belong to messenger transmission, not coercive control over the response.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of the known to the knower assigns complete recipient knowledge to the Lord.
Messenger and message defines the addressee's delegated communicative role.
One who manages an affair by sufficiency and preservation names the role explicitly denied to the messenger.
Knowledge extending across heavens and earth expands the divine scope beyond the immediate audience.
Differentiated rank supplies a non-uniform distribution of prophetic roles within that scope.
One who reports from God supplies the prophetic transmission function.
Writing and book supplies another differentiated medium of transmission.
Lordship and sovereignty locates ownership of the encompassing field.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and possession anchors the divine side of the role distinction.

structural_cues: In 17:54-55, ربكم أعلم and وربك أعلم bracket the statement that the messenger was not sent as وكيل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine knowledge, messenger sending, and an explicit non-custodian clause; I infer a division between encompassing governance and non-coercive transmission, while the live alternative reads وكيل as denying only liability rather than control.

changed_reading.before: If the warning increases transgression, the communicative act appears to fail.
changed_reading.after: The counter-response does not negate the messenger's assigned act: enclosure governs outcomes, while showing and warning transmit without custodial control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those invoked besides God cannot uncover harm or transform it, while the invoked beings themselves seek proximity, hope for mercy, fear punishment, and remain cautious. Fear therefore is not a deterministic stimulus; its output depends on relational direction, producing approach and caution here but swelling transgression in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Removing a covering from harm supplies the relief falsely sought from subordinate objects.
Transformation from one state to another names the power those objects lack.
Seeking supplies an active orientation toward the Lord rather than away from warning.
Nearness opposed to distance gives that seeking a directional endpoint.
The heart's expectation of what is hoped for balances fear with attraction.
Fear as expectation of harm here contributes to approach and restraint rather than overflow.
Alert guarding against danger supplies fear's cautious output.
Inducing fear anchors the contrasting stimulus in the focus.
Sweeping overflow supplies the opposite output produced by resistant orientation.

structural_cues: Verse 17:57 balances يَرْجُونَ with يَخَافُونَ and proximity-seeking; 17:60 repeats fear but follows it with increase into transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same fear root in opposed response sequences; I infer that relational orientation mediates the effect, while the live alternative is that one fear belongs to worship and the other to warning without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: Warning itself drives people into transgression.
changed_reading.after: Warning exposes direction: fear can orient a recipient toward proximity and caution or, under resistant reception, be converted into greater overflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: A written horizon of communal destruction leads into an explicit restriction on sending signs because earlier peoples denied them. A conspicuously visible she-camel is then wrongfully handled, and sent signs are assigned the role of warning. The focus's vision and Qur'anic tree become mediated signs inside this restrained sign regime, with their counter-effect continuing the historical pattern rather than demanding ever more spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Written fixation that entails judgment supplies the settled horizon behind the warning.
An ordered written line makes that horizon textually laid out before the sign discussion.
A barrier between an agent and an intended act supplies the restriction on spectacular sign sending.
Sending and dispatch supplies the governed movement of signs toward recipients.
A manifest mark identifies the dispatched material as publicly legible signs.
Assigning a sign to falsehood supplies the historical response that restricts further sending.
The she-camel and its concrete form supplies the exemplary material sign.
Direct visual perception marks that sign as conspicuous rather than evidentially obscure.
Putting a thing in the wrong place supplies the recipients' corrupt handling of the visible sign.
Inducing fear states the assigned function of dispatched signs immediately before the focus.
Showing anchors the focus vision as a mediated successor within the sign regime.
Recitation locates the tree sign in a textual medium rather than another demanded spectacle.
The repeated act of inducing fear directly continues the assigned function from 17:59.

structural_cues: Verse 17:59 ends وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِالْآيَاتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا and 17:60 immediately continues وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا, while both verses pair visual signs with adverse reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct adjacency, repeated warning morphology, sign restriction, and historical denial; I infer that the vision and tree are mediated signs selected within a restrained regime, while the live alternative treats 17:59 and 17:60 as separate examples without policy continuity.

changed_reading.before: The vision and tree are two arbitrary tests whose warning happens to fail.
changed_reading.after: They are contained, mediated signs deployed after spectacular signs have repeatedly been denied; their role is warning and diagnostic exposure, not escalation into an endless spectacle contest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare la'in branch for a field effigy rather than the ordinary curse branch. It remains valid as a material analogy because the effigy branch is attached to the exact modifier of the focus tree and the verse itself immediately names induced fear; downstream prose should call it a branch-image analogy, never replace mal'una with scarecrow.

activation_trace.role: A stemmed tree supplies the field object to which the unusual effigy image attaches.
A human-shaped field effigy that frightens animals supplies an object-warning mechanism.
Putting fear into others states the intended repelling action of that mechanism.
Growth supplies the paradoxical strengthening instead of retreat.
Sweeping overflow supplies the failed effigy's opposite behavioral result.

changed_reading.before: The cursed tree is only the content of a warning.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the tree resembles a warning effigy meant to drive creatures back but perversely followed by approach, growth, and overflow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it composes three non-dominant split-root branches: rabb with growth, ra'y with water carriage, and ziyada with travel provision. It remains anchored because every split mapping is explicitly present for the focus roots and joins the literal tree and flood branch; downstream prose should present an ecological material analogy, not an etymology or lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبَّكَ ... الرُّءْيَا الَّتِي أَرَيْنَاكَ ... الشَّجَرَةَ ... يَزِيدُهُمْ ... طُغْيَانًا

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growth supplies a cultivated growth field under the packet's split mapping.
Bringing and carrying water supplies irrigation as an analogy for transmitting the vision.
The stemmed tree gives the irrigated process a literal growth anchor.
Carrying provisions for movement turns increase into fuel for a continuing trajectory.
Water exceeding its measure supplies the endpoint where irrigation becomes flood.

changed_reading.before: Warning is an external brake that recipients resist.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material model, transmitting the sign can look like irrigating and provisioning countergrowth until the supplied water exceeds measure and floods.

strongest_changes: The exact counter-effect frame in 17:41 and the sign-warning continuation in 17:59 turn 17:60 from an isolated paradox into a recurrent reception pattern.
The barriers of 17:45-46 revise seeing and recitation into an occluded interface whose output is diagnostically exposed by fitna.
The stone-and-iron sequence of 17:49-52 activates fitna as a material assay, while 17:53 activates the tree as socially interlaced conflict.
The knowledge and non-custodian sequence of 17:54-55 separates divine enclosure from messenger control, and 17:57 shows that fear's effect depends on relational direction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses visual showing, recited image, public assay, warning, and adverse growth into one feedback system; nearby context repeatedly changes the mechanism without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet keeps dream vision, ocular or inward seeing, causative showing, and split-root narration or watering live; the exact medium of الرؤيا should remain unresolved.
The tree may remain a concrete botanical sign, a represented image, an interlaced social-conflict model, or an ecological analogy; the latter readings require explicit containment.
The syntax states that warning is followed by increase, but whether warning causes, occasions, exposes, or accelerates the recipients' own increase remains inferential.
